1. [consensus] [Important] Discount usage is consumed before payment and can exceed the cap
   证据：src/checkout.ts:29 `          `UPDATE discount_codes SET usedCount = usedCount + 1 WHERE id = ${applied.id}``
   `usedCount` increments before `charge`, so a declined payment burns a use. The `> maxUses` read-then-update is also non-atomic: `usedCount == maxUses` is accepted, and concurrent checkouts exceed the cap. Increment after success with atomic `WHERE usedCount < maxUses`.
   发现者：correctness, security；voter：valid — voter1: Line 29 increments usedCount before charge() at line 34, so a failed payment burns a use; the `> maxUses` check plus non-atomic read-then-update also lets the cap be exceeded.

2. [solo] [Important] Fully used discount code is still accepted
   证据：src/checkout.ts:46 `    if (dc.usedCount > dc.maxUses) return null;`
   `usedCount > maxUses` admits a code when `usedCount === maxUses`, then increments past the limit. Use `>=` and enforce the limit atomically in the UPDATE to prevent concurrent overuse.
   发现者：correctness；voter：valid — voter1: Line 46 uses `usedCount > maxUses`, so a code with usedCount === maxUses is accepted and then incremented past the limit at line 29.

3. [solo] [Important] Discount tests assert fractional cents and skip expiry
   证据：src/checkout.test.ts:29 `    expect(res.chargedCents).toBe(2697.3);`
   The expectation codifies 2697.3 fractional cents, so an integer-rounding fix would fail it; the expired case is `it.skip` and the mock returns unexpired SAVE10 for every `discount_codes` query, so expiry is untested.
   发现者：correctness；voter：valid — voter1: Test asserts 2697.3 (fractional cents), the expired case is it.skip at line 32, and the mock returns unexpired SAVE10 regardless of code, so expiry is never exercised.

4. [solo] [Important] SQL injection in discount-code lookup
   证据：src/checkout.ts:42 `    const rows = await this.db.query(`SELECT * FROM discount_codes WHERE code = '${code}'`);`
   `code` is caller-controlled and interpolated directly into SQL, so a value like `' OR '1'='1` can alter the query. The UPDATE at line 29 is also unparameterized. Use `WHERE code = $1` and `WHERE id = $2` with bound parameters.
   发现者：security；voter：valid — voter1: Line 42 interpolates caller-controlled `code` directly into the SELECT, allowing quote-based SQL injection; the line 29 UPDATE is likewise unparameterized.

5. [solo] [Important] Invalid discount codes silently charge full price
   证据：src/checkout.ts:25 `      applied = await this.lookupCode(discountCode);`
   When `lookupCode` returns null for an unknown, expired, or exhausted code, checkout continues at full price and returns `ok`; the caller gets no indication the supplied code was rejected. Return an explicit error/result or reject before charging.
   发现者：security；voter：valid — voter1: lookupCode returns null for unknown/expired/exhausted codes, yet checkout falls through to full-price charge and returns status ok with no rejection signal.

6. [solo] [Important] Expired-code test is skipped
   证据：src/checkout.test.ts:32 `  it.skip("rejects expired code", async () => {`
   The only expired-code test is disabled with `it.skip`, so expiration is never verified. It asserts a full-price charge rather than an explicit rejection, hiding which behavior is intended. Enable it and assert the chosen contract.
   发现者：security；voter：valid — voter1: The only expired-code test is disabled with it.skip at line 32, so expiration handling is unverified; its assertion of full-price 100 also leaves rejection behavior undefined.
